d:
After a week of intensive search operations across nearly three dozen villages, Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) commander Lateef Bhatt was killed in an encounter with security forces in Kashmir’s Kulgam district early Wednesday. According to sources in the security establishment, Bhatt was hiding inside a mosque in Kulgam’s Zungalpora village when security forces asked him to come out and surrender. A conversation also took place over a video call, but Bhatt refused to surrender while reciting verses from the Quran.
